source_caption_text:
Adin Ross really paid $10K for GTA 6 just for someone from his stream to steal the code 😭😭😂

He bought what he thought was a disc that would let him play the game early, but when he opened it on stream, it came with a code instead. Someone watching redeemed it before he could use it, and Adin was heated when he realized what happened 💀

Spending $10,000 to get ahead of everyone just to have a viewer beat you to your own code is an insane turn of events 😭🎮

That might’ve been the most expensive unboxing of his life 😂

Via; @adinross
